A 2-bed, maybe a 3 if the rocks are right. $3–4k. Better views over a bigger house. Not Cottonwood. Thunder Mountain, Distant Drums, Chavez / Enchantment, Cathedral Rock. Look around late next week. Seth is in New York mid-September through October, then Paris.

The truth West Sedona Cathedral / VOC Tour plan Call scripts

The honest picture

$3–4k is a real house budget in Sedona. A formation view is possible if the street is lucky. A custom house on Thunder Mountain Ranch, Distant Drums, Chavez / Enchantment, or Cathedral-front is not. Those sell in the millions or rent above $4,500.

The tighter problem is inventory. About 50 long-term rentals citywide. The streets we already love have nothing listed today. Off-market, through local property managers, is the actual path. Calls Monday through Wednesday. Interiors Thursday and Friday. They will not show on a weekend. October 1 is the start that fits New York. Mid-September only if a unit is already empty and we apply Thursday.

West Sedona

Closest to Thunder Mountain, the Stupa, Coffee Pot. Distant Drums, Chavez, Enchantment, Andante, and Thunder Mountain Road are empty this week.

If we go late next week

Drive Tucson to Sedona and you hit VOC first. Still: do interiors Thursday and Friday. Saturday and Sunday are drive-bys only.

Thursday

West 89A offices, then west loops while the light is on Thunder Mountain.

  1. Walk in: Sedona Elite (1725 W 89A), Foothills (1615 W 89A), Sedona Rentals (1487 W 89A). Ask for off-market 2/2s, Sept 15 / Oct 1, formation views.
  2. See 2285 Sanborn if they will show it.
  3. Coffee Pot, Andante, Amitabha Stupa drive-bys.
  4. Distant Drums late afternoon, to calibrate, not to hunt a lease.

Friday

Any interiors they released, then south.

  1. 105 Sycamore if we want the photo-backed VOC view.
  2. 130 Castle Rock 11 if small is fine.
  3. 200 Cathedral Rock Drive as a drive-by.
  4. Chavez Ranch / Enchantment to remember what we already liked.

What to say Monday

Four people. Same story. Apply-ready: IDs, paystubs or returns, credit, pet docs if any. Both of us apply. They do not take cosigners. Income needs to look like about 3× rent.
